elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies the cap to “each Party’s aggregate liability.”

elements.element: The fee component of the cap includes Fees both paid and payable.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 expressly uses “Fees paid or payable.”

elements.element: The fee component is measured over the 12 months preceding the claim.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 specifies “the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.”

elements.element: The cap includes USD 1,000,000 as the alternative amount.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 expressly includes “USD 1,000,000.”

elements.element: The cap is the greater of the 12-month fee component and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 caps liability at “the greater of” the stated fee component and USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Indirect and consequential damages are excluded on a mutual basis.
elements.evidence: Section 21.2 provides that “neither Party” is liable for indirect or consequential damages and related enumerated losses, subject to the same Excluded Claims exception for both parties.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 makes a Party’s confidentiality breach an Excluded Claim, and Section 21.1 exempts Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of data-protection obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 makes a Party’s breach of data-protection obligations an Excluded Claim, and Section 21.1 exempts Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 makes a Party’s breach of security obligations an Excluded Claim, and Section 21.1 exempts Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Indemnification obligations are uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 makes a Party’s indemnification obligations Excluded Claims, and Section 21.1 exempts Excluded Claims from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes gross negligence within Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 exempts from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes wilful misconduct within Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 exempts from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for fraud is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes fraud within Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 exempts from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for infringement of the other party’s intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 includes infringement or misappropriation of the other Party’s intellectual property within Excluded Claims, which Section 21.1 exempts from the cap.

elements.element: Customer’s payment obligations are not damages for purposes of the cap.
elements.evidence: Section 21.3 treats only payment obligations for “undisputed amounts due” as not damages. The preferred position is unqualified and therefore also covers payment obligations that are disputed but ultimately determined to be payable.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies the cap to “each Party’s aggregate liability.”

elements.element: The cap provides a 12-month Fees measure.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 uses Fees paid or payable in the preceding 12 months. Its additional USD 1,000,000 floor is the more protective preferred formulation and does not reduce the fallback’s 12-month fee measure.

elements.element: Indemnification obligations are uncapped.
elements.evidence: Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3 and are outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Confidentiality breaches are Excluded Claims under Section 21.3 and are outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and is outside the Section 21.1 cap.

elements.element: Liability for wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim under Section 21.3 and is outside the Section 21.1 cap.

result.reason: The operative clause satisfies the mutual cap, greater-of calculation, mutual damages exclusion, and all requested uncapped carve-outs. It does not fully satisfy the preferred payment-obligation requirement because the operative carve-out is limited to undisputed amounts due; the margin comment cannot cure that limitation. The fallback is satisfied because the clause provides the mutual 12-month Fees measure and all four required uncapped carve-outs. The edits are targeted and preserve the surrounding direct-damages treatment and other commercial terms.
